detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with permission to search `index=contactcenter`.
• Install and configure: Genesys Cloud integration, Splunk ITSI contact center module.
• Ensure `cc:event` events are flowing (prerequisite UC: none when applicable).
• Map `contactcenter` and field extractions per `docs/guides/industry-verticals.md`.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Ingest `cc:event` events via HEC or Edge Hub into `index=contactcenter`. Normalize field extractions in props/transforms for the Contact Center and CX Operations feed. Save as a scheduled search or real-time alert; tune thresholds using a 14-day baseline.
Expected sourcetype: `cc:event`. Validate with:
```spl
index=contactcenter sourcetype="cc:event" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=contactcenter sourcetype="cc:event"
| stats count as event_count dc(host) as distinct_hosts by _time span=1h
| where event_count > 0
| table _time event_count distinct_hosts
```

Understanding this SPL
The search scopes `cc:event` in `index=contactcenter` and applies `*` to surface `Cross-vertical MITRE ATT&CK for ICS mapping (energy/mfg/oil)`. Tune time range and alert threshold to your operational baseline; exclude planned maintenance via asset/schedule lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare result counts to the source system UI (SCADA HMI, EHR interface engine, POS gateway, OSS/BSS console, etc.) for the same time range. Spot-check `_time` and asset fields.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `21_14_29_alert` with appropriate severity. Dashboard: Timechart by host/asset, single-value KPI, table of top offenders..
Failure modes: (1) empty results — verify HEC/Edge Hub input and index routing; (2) duplicate events — check forwarder acknowledgment; (3) missing fields — review props/transforms; (4) alert fatigue — add CMDB/allow-list exclusions documented in knownFalsePositives.
